name: print-social-pixel-retro-coffee-brand-feed-in-violet-orange-yellow
title: Retro-game coffee brand feed with pixel icons in violet, orange, yellow and black
whatItIs: A 3x4 Instagram grid of square posts with pixel-art coffee cups, coffee makers, clouds and 8-bit gadgets. Colours alternate violet, orange, yellow and black, with pixel fonts for messages like 'Coffee brewing methods' and packaging renders of cans and cups.
whatItMeans: Nostalgic and playful; game imagery makes coffee content feel like an arcade.
techniques: Draw all icons on a strict pixel grid.
Rotate through four flat background colours.
Mix pixel graphics with realistic product renders.
bestFor: Coffee and food brands with a gamer audience

vocabulary.definition: A strict square grid for drawing blocky art.
A retro game look with limited colours and blocky shapes.
Cycling backgrounds through a set of colours.
